agent_note: Third-person past-tense narration with a strong essayistic/aphoristic overlay - the gnomic quotes are all genuinely present-tense sententiae, while the book's exposition and summary are uniformly past. Quotation marks survive inconsistently: two quotes keep them, three clear speech passages have none, so dialogue there was judged on dialect register, speech tags, and direct address. Deliberately did NOT file past-tense generalizations (q07866, q07874, q07875, q07876) as gnomic. Event evidence is 11/11 past.
